title: feat(spec): a hook declares its refusal catalogue, and its body refuses by code, answered in the caller's language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBNwSiQjPk36YGpZnrxAs9yW)_

Fixes #26170

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #26834

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按裁决 A，Hook 新增 `refusals: { CODE: { message, status? } }` 拒绝目录；沙箱 body 只按 code 拒绝，运行时用目录里的消息（经 `hooks.HOOK.refusals.CODE.message` 按调用方语言翻译）和状态码作答。
- 为什么改：hook 的业务拒绝是用户最常读到的"不行"，却是唯一没有翻译键的拒绝入口（校验规则、flow 拒绝都已有）。
- 风险与回滚：只对声明了 `refusals` 的 hook 生效，未声明的 hook 行为完全不变；没有 js body 的 hook（进程内 handler、表达式 body）声明 `refusals` 会在保存时被拒；回滚即 revert 本 PR。新增翻译分组 `hooks` 连带改了控制台翻译预览、i18n 文档和 walk-parity 夹具。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-refusal-catalogue.ts`、`packages/spec/src/data/hook-refusal-codes.ts`、`hook.zod.ts` 的 `refusals`。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/runtime && npx vitest run src/sandbox/hook-refusal-catalogue.test.ts`（17 项：声明码、翻译、协商、未声明码 500、宿主错误透传）。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 触及 `skills/**`（受治理面），需维护者合并；拒绝消息暂不带参数（`{{ }}` 现在保存时即拒，以后加参数是纯增量），见 Acceptance notes。

## What changes

Ruling A (6431311681), as bound by the order:

- **`@objectstack/spec`**
  - `HookSchema.refusals`: a record keyed by a SCREAMING_SNAKE code (`HOOK_REFUSAL_CODE_PATTERN`) of `HookRefusalSchema` = `{ message, status? }`, closed, `status` 400–499 (default 400). Aliases name `reason`/`text`/`description` → `message` and `httpStatus`/`statusCode` → `status`.
  - A catalogue is answered only on the sandboxed `body` path, so `refusals` on a hook with no `js` body (an in-process `handler`, an expression body) is refused at save, at `refusals`, naming the remedy (move the refusing logic into a `js` body, or drop `refusals`).
  - A refusal `message` is plain text: a `{{ }}` hole is refused at save, by a pattern the published JSON Schema carries too, so a later params slot stays additive.
  - Save-time refusal (`refuseUndeclaredLiteralRefusalCode` superRefine): when a hook declares `refusals` and its js body throws a code literally (`{ code: 'X' }` in a `throw`, or `e.code = 'X'` on a name thrown bare) that the catalogue does not declare, the parse fails at `body.source`. The reader (`hook-refusal-codes.ts`, an import-free leaf) masks comments and string contents first, so a `throw` or `code:` written inside either is never read.
  - Translation: a new `hooks` group, `hooks.HOOK.refusals.CODE.message`, on the per-app and platform faces, and `hookRefusalMessageKey`. The group counts in prose move by one: fifteen → sixteen per-app and sixteen → seventeen on the platform face, after the main merge that brought #26819's `books` group. One TSDoc line (`translation.zod.ts` ~:2082, `TranslationDataSchema`) still says "Fifteen groups"; it is fixed in a trailing docs PR after this one lands (contract review round 4, 6458660736).
  - `HookContext.session.locale` declares the caller's locale.
  - Liveness rows `hook/refusals` (with `message` and `status` children) and `translation/hooks`.
- **`@objectstack/objectql`**: `buildSession` copies `ExecutionContext.locale` onto a session that exists (a locale alone never makes one).
- **`@objectstack/runtime`**
  - `hook-refusal-catalogue.ts`: `resolveHookRefusal` answers a sandboxed body's throw. A declared code becomes a `SandboxError` with the translated (else declared) message as `innerMessage` and `userMessage`, the declared code, and the entry's status. Any other throw from the body (an undeclared code, or none) becomes a 500 fault naming the hook and the code. The locale is negotiated with `resolveBundleLocale` against the i18n service's locales, read lazily at refusal time.
  - `body-runner.ts` calls it in the hook catch; `app-plugin.ts` and `app-artifact-handlers.ts` pass the lazy `i18n` reader.
  - `quickjs-runner.ts`: a marshalled host error carries a non-enumerable marker of the `message` and `code` it crossed with, so an error a `ctx.api` call raised and the body let leave unchanged passes through untouched (`isHostRelayedSandboxError`); one the body rewrote is the body's own.
- **`@objectstack/cli`**: `os i18n extract` walks `hooks[].refusals` (one key per declared entry) and `os i18n check` counts them in a new `hook` coverage bucket.
- **`@objectstack/lint`**: `translation-target-unknown` judges `hooks.NAME` against the stack's hooks (sibling packages' included) and `hooks.NAME.refusals.CODE` against that hook's declared codes, with a nearest-name suggestion.
- **Ripples of the new group**: the console translation preview gains a `hooks` category (en/zh labels) and the loader's group list gains `hooks` (`ui/`); `i18n-standard.mdx` and `ui/translations.mdx`; the walk-parity fixture authors one hook with a catalogue; `CARD_PROPERTY_COUNTS.hook` 22 → 23.
- **Skills**: `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` teaches `refusals`.
- Changeset: minor for spec, runtime, objectql, cli, lint; patch for `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell` (the loader's group list and the translation preview move).

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/data/hook-refusals.test.ts` (new, 52): the schema, the save-time refusal, `refusals` refused beside a `handler` or an expression body, a `{{ }}` hole refused, the literal reader (positive and negative shapes, comments and strings masked), the sentences, the translation path, `session.locale`.
- `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-refusal-catalogue.test.ts` (new, 17): through the real factory and QuickJS runner, read off `mapDataError`: declared code with default and declared status, zh-CN translation, `zh` → `zh-CN` negotiation, fallback, no service, undeclared and missing code as 500, a hook without `refusals` unchanged, a crash unchanged, a host error passed through, a host error re-coded by the body judged.
- `packages/cli/test/i18n-hook-refusal-coverage.test.ts` (new, 7): walker, coverage bucket, skeleton parses through the schema.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.test.ts` (+5): the hooks arm.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-execution-plumbing.session-locale.test.ts` (new, 3).
- Ablation (on-disk mutation, restored after): with the body runner's `resolveHookRefusal` call replaced by `err`, 9 of the 17 runtime tests fail; with the host-relay marker not recorded, the passthrough test fails.

## Acceptance notes

- **The OPEN item (throw shape versus `api.refuse`), measured:** the existing throw shape carries `code` across the VM already (`__errorInfo`), so the body spells a refusal `throw Object.assign(new Error(), { code: 'X' })`, and no new API was added. **Params are not carried:** a declared message is plain text, translated whole, like a validation rule's message (no parameter contract). I did not treat this as a fork, because the ruling's catalogue has no param slot either. A `{{ }}` hole is refused at save now, so a later params slot (e.g. `params` on the thrown error) is purely additive.
- **On the wire** an author's code is not an ADR-0112 registered one, so the envelope's `code` is the status's registered code (`VALIDATION_ERROR` for 400, `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` for 409) and the declared code rides as `declaredCode`, the existing demotion contract. The skills doc says so.
- **Enforcement scope:** the undeclared-code refusal applies only to a hook that declares `refusals`; every existing hook is answered as before, so the change is non-breaking. A catalogue is served only on the sandboxed `body` path, so `refusals` on a hook with no `js` body is refused at save rather than wired into the in-process `handler` wrap (that would widen past the card).
- **Outside the order's file surface, and why:** `packages/objectql/src/engine-execution-plumbing.ts` (the producer of `session.locale`; the runtime had no other way to read the caller's locale), `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` and `app-artifact-handlers.ts` (wiring the i18n reader), the `ui/` translation-preview and loader lists (an exhaustive `satisfies Record` over the translation groups fails type-check otherwise), the i18n docs, the walk-parity fixture, and the metadata-protocol property count.
- **Studio hook form:** `refusals` is not offered. The form's `record` editor stamps each entry's key into the entry, and a refusal entry is closed at `message`/`status` (the key is the code), so a stamped key would be refused. The form gate's ledger records this omission. Offering it needs a key-only record control, filed as #26835.
- **Skills, line and token counts:** `data-hooks.md` 998 → 972 lines; the `skills/objectstack-data` markdown package 3849 → 3823 lines. The new section was paid for under the file's token ceiling by deleting error-handling examples the handler and `onError` sections already carry (10063 of 10066 tokens).
- No `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm, so no full dogfood run is owed.

## Verification

**At head `e55978368d`.** Main is merged through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` three times, last at `a20824f366` with #26859. Each merge took main's side of the generated artifacts and regenerated them as their own commit. Every run is under `os-verify-lock`.

- **r1 change (`c19dbcd0d4`):**

  - With `hook.test.ts`, the translation tests and the ADR-0122 pin: 342 passed.
  - `spec typecheck`: exit 0.
  - `check:generated --fix`: wrote `api-surface`, `export-origins` and the `hook.mdx` reference.
  - I first tried a refinement for the hole refusal. The build refused it, because the published JSON Schema could not carry it (dropped-refinements ledger, 5 sites). A pattern carries it, so no ledger rows are added.
  - `check-skills-token-ratchet`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-empty-changeset`: exit 0.
- **On the merged tree:**
  - Full `pnpm build`: exit 0.
  - `spec check:generated`: all 14 current after the regen commit.
  - `actionKeys.pin.test.ts`: 19 of 19 (#26859).
  - The nine whole packages of CI's `Test Core (6/8)` shard: 44 of 44 turbo tasks, on the `8f7675f85b` tree.
  - Suites: spec 22093 passed (736 files); runtime 7474 passed (461 files); cli 6460 passed (519 files); lint 7453 passed (169 files); objectql 8846 passed (476 files). `check:i18n` exit 0.
  - Dispatch gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 130 families, and all 130 were run with each exit code recorded before any pipe. All 130 exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 130 derived, 130 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0.
- **CI at this head:** all 62 check-runs completed, 57 success and 5 opt-in skips.
- **Before r1** (head `78dc14528e`, main merged at `c8583f80ac`):
  - Suites: spec 22063, runtime 7465, lint 7435, objectql 8846, cli i18n 13, ui 1445.
  - Dispatch gates: 130 derived, 130 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- **Dogfood:** not owed (no `!`, no narrowing arm).
